parties:
Biswaswar Das Karmakar& others ----- Appellants
Vs. 
Sasanka Mohan Das Karmakar& others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: "A party setting up a will is required to prove that the testator was of sound disposing mind when he made his will but, in the absence of any evidence as to the state of the testator's mind, proof that he has executed a will rational in character in the presence of witnesses must lead to a presumption that he was of sound mind, and understood, what he was about."
